skim.title: A Day at School
skim.subtitle: Read quickly and find the main idea!
sentences: Maya arrives at school in the morning.
Good morning, Ms. Hart!
Good morning, Maya! It is good to see you!
Leo arrives at school, too.
Hi, Leo! It is nice to see you!
Good afternoon! says Ms. Hart after lunch.
Good afternoon, Ms. Hart! says Maya.
At the end of the day, Ms. Hart says: Have a nice day!
See you later! say Maya and Leo.
Good night! says Leo at home.
Take care! says Maya.
translations: Ms. Hart öğleden sonra 'İyi öğleden sonralar!' der.
İyi öğleden sonralar, Ms. Hart! der Maya.
Günün sonunda Ms. Hart şöyle der: İyi günler!

skim.title: School Rules
skim.subtitle: Read quickly and find the main idea!
sentences: Ms. Hart has a list of school rules.
You must be on time at school.
You must listen to your teacher.
You must keep the classroom clean.
You mustn't run in the corridor.
You mustn't shout in the library.
You mustn't use your phone at school.
Leo asks: What is that?
That is the school rules board, says Ms. Hart.
Maya says: Cool! I know all the rules!
Ms. Hart says: Have a good day, everyone!
translations: Ms. Hart'ın bir okul kuralları listesi var.
O okul kuralları panosu, diyor Ms. Hart.
Maya diyor: Harika! Tüm kuralları biliyorum!
Ms. Hart diyor: Herkese iyi günler!

inf.title: A Surprise at School
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: It is a cold morning in February.
Maya arrives at school early.
She finds something in the corridor.
There is a big box near the library.
Maya asks Mr. Cole: What is that?
Mr. Cole says: I don't know. Ask Ms. Hart!
Maya must find Ms. Hart.
She runs to the office.
Ms. Hart smiles and says nothing.
Leo arrives and sees the box, too.
Leo asks: Is that a surprise?
Ms. Hart says: Wait and see!
Later, everyone is happy.
translations: Kütüphanenin yanında büyük bir kutu var.
Maya Mr. Cole'a soruyor: O nedir?
Mr. Cole diyor: Bilmiyorum. Ms. Hart'a sor!
Ms. Hart gülümsüyor ve hiçbir şey söylemiyor.
Leo da geliyor ve kutuyu görüyor.
Leo soruyor: Bu bir sürpriz mi?
Ms. Hart diyor: Bekle ve gör!

questions.hint: Read the first sentence carefully.

questions.hint: Find the word box in the text.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Hart say nothing?
questions.correct: Because the box is a surprise.

inf.title: When Is the Party?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: Maya has a big smile today.
Leo asks: When is your birthday, Maya?
Maya says: It is in May!
Leo asks: What month is it now?
It is July, says Ms. Hart.
Leo thinks: May is before July.
Leo asks: Is your birthday party in the summer holiday?
Maya smiles and says: Yes!
Ms. Hart says: Have a good weekend, everyone!
Maya says: Thank you! See you later!
At home, Maya decorates her room with balloons.
There are gifts and candles on the table.
Maya is very happy. Her birthday party is soon!
translations: Maya bugün büyük bir gülümsemeyle geliyor.
Leo soruyor: Doğum günün ne zaman, Maya?
Leo soruyor: Şu an hangi ay?
Leo düşünüyor: Mayıs, Temmuz'dan önce gelir.
Leo soruyor: Doğum günü partisi yaz tatilinde mi?
Ms. Hart diyor: Herkese iyi hafta sonları!
Maya çok mutlu. Doğum günü partisi yakında!
